statement: The USGS ComCat catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with epicenter within 300 km of USGS event us6000tjl2 and origin time between 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-14.
resolution: A ComCat query on the deadline returns at least one M 6.0 or greater event meeting the distance and origin-time criteria.
failure_condition: ComCat contains no qualifying M 6.0 or greater event within 300 km for the stated origin window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The WHO Director-General declares the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern between 2026-08-15 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: A WHO announcement of a PHEIC determination for the DRC Ebola outbreak, published on who.int within the window.
failure_condition: WHO makes no PHEIC determination for this outbreak within the window, regardless of case counts or committee meetings.
